assumptions: Original Supabase catalog unavailable; this is a replacement schema, not an exact catalog export.
Numeric financial values use arbitrary-precision numeric; JSON objects and arrays use jsonb.
New FK mappings follow caller identifiers; deletion is RESTRICT except ephemeral map child levels.
Trading RPC accounting is reconstructed and documented; production acceptance requires Buddy4 test DB runs.
Existing five schemas are retained from migrations 001-004; drift checks fail rather than silently repair.
